checks: Exact half-open block allocation handles empty blocks and zero sizes.
Frame and dense-work capacities are separate: m,q<=N provides square frame capacity; m*C and q*C<=N remain explicit dense-work premises.
SVD disjointness and protection use actual writeSVD output blocks, not a mathematical evaluator.
Contraction reads frame transpose with row stride1/column strideq; lifting reads row strideq/column stride1.
Address and endAddress bounds derive from literal layout expressions and original Size bounds.
authorship_exclusions: My authored SVD and matrix-memory prerequisites are not independently approved by this review.
